source: Retrofit extension rules (Retrofit's own, PRD 6.6). Not in APPETITE_GUIDELINES.pdf: they can raise REFER or a contradiction and feed the premium, and they never touch the appetite score. The flood-zone rules are the one place external enrichment reaches a decision: `worstFloodZoneTier` is fed by the OpenFEMA National Flood Hazard Layer, so a fetched zone can move an account to REFER and change its predicted premium.

citation.quote: Retrofit's own rule: at least 50% of TIV in sprinklered buildings is target and earns the sprinklered rate.
Retrofit's own rule: less than 50% of TIV sprinklered, on $100M of TIV or less, is acceptable at the unsprinklered rate.

rules.fixHint: Sprinkler the largest unsprinklered buildings until at least half of TIV is protected.

citation.quote: Retrofit's own rule: less than 50% of TIV sprinklered on more than $100M of TIV is referred to an underwriter.

rules.fixHint: Sprinkler the largest unsprinklered buildings until at least half of TIV is protected.

citation.quote: Retrofit's own rule: a TIV-weighted protection class of 4 or better is target.
Retrofit's own rule: a TIV-weighted protection class worse than 4 and better than 9 is acceptable.
Retrofit's own rule: a TIV-weighted protection class of 9 or 10 is effectively unprotected and is referred to an underwriter.
Retrofit's own rule: every location outside the mapped Special Flood Hazard Area (FEMA zone X, X500 or D) is target and earns the base flood rate.
Retrofit's own rule: any location inside a FEMA Special Flood Hazard Area (zone A, AE, AO, AH, AR or A99) is referred to an underwriter and rated for flood.

rules.fixHint: Flood is an underwriting decision, not something the insured can move: the building cannot leave the flood plain. A referral asks for an elevation certificate and a flood sublimit.

citation.quote: Retrofit's own rule: a location in a coastal high-hazard zone with wave action (FEMA zone V or VE) is referred to an underwriter and rated at the coastal flood load.

rules.fixHint: Flood is an underwriting decision, not something the insured can move: the building cannot leave the coastal V zone. A referral asks for an elevation certificate and a flood sublimit.

interpretations.title: Extension rules are Retrofit's, not Federato's
interpretations.decision: Sprinkler, protection-class and flood-zone rules are labelled as Retrofit's own everywhere. They can raise REFER or a contradiction and feed the premium; they carry no weight and never change the appetite score.

citation.quote: They can raise REFER or a contradiction and feed the premium, and they never touch the appetite score, so the score stays defensible against Federato's document.
